page.layout: One printed page (left), with numbered theses 196 to 206 in one column, running head at top, page numbers at top left and foot right. Right side of the scan shows only a cut-off strip of the neighbouring page, which is left out.

main_text.p: 196 Quicquid affirmatur & negatur de specie, etiam affirmatur & negatur de genere particulariter.
198 Quod proximè prædicatur de individuis est genus.
199 Nulla species, quâ species, est prædicabilis sed tantum subjicibilis.
200 Eadem res potest esse genus respectu inferiorum & species respectu superiorum.
201 Dantur legitimæ distributiones, quæ neque sunt integri in membra, neque generis in species.
203 Distinctionis partes referuntur ad argumenta diffentanea, sed tota distinctio ad distributionem.
204 Distributio subjecti in adjuncta, & aliæ distributiones ejusdem generis, non sunt imperfectæ distributiones, sed in suo genere perfectæ.
205 Distinctio vocis ambiguæ pro varietate rerum quas significat, est distributio adjuncti in sua subjecta.
206 Distinctio rei per varia nomina est distributio subjecti in sua adjuncta.

page.notes: The top "38" and the foot "207" are both printed page numbers and are recorded together. Printed "fpecialif-" is read as "specialif-" with the hyphen kept at the line end. Some words are partly obscured by ink or the binding (e.g. "diffentanea", "distributionem"), but were read as printed. The right-hand strip belongs to the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.
